scripts.format: prettier --write src worker shared tests scripts *.ts *.js package.json wrangler.jsonc
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src worker shared tests scripts *.ts *.js package.json wrangler.jsonc
scripts.ci:build: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:runtime
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/check-build.mjs production && npm run test:runtime && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config dist/work/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:ci: node scripts/check-build.mjs production && npm run test:runtime && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config dist/work/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging npm run build && node scripts/check-build.mjs staging && npm run test:runtime && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config dist/work/wrangler.json
